trusted_authorities.relevant_constraint: FC-00X is shared infrastructure and does not authorize FC-01 or any feature task.

frozen_scope.scene: Reuse existing SceneBinding, IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator, FullSceneCompiler and RuntimeSceneProjection; add adapters/ports only where required for one shared composition.
frozen_scope.resources: Use one pull-plus-notify model. The Document ResourceManifest is the authority for Image/Font/Brush resource id, kind, ResourceRevision, expected sha256 content hash, byte length and decode/layout metadata. At attach/open, composition receives a copied internal ResourceBindingSnapshot derived from that manifest; Host/provider supplies immutable bytes/results only and never becomes the metadata authority. Existing canonical BrushResourceBinding metadata must agree with the manifest entry. Missing manifest representation, missing expected hash, or mismatched metadata keeps a resource unverified/missing and cannot publish Ready. Runtime validates at the owner safe point.
frozen_scope.composition: Per-instance manual-poll Runtime composition with full lifecycle and close protocol; no duplicate Document, Session, History, RuntimeScene or canonical write owner.
frozen_scope.consumers: Windows first, then Web debug-on/off, using the same composition; Minimal core must not link Playground or Debug UI.

forbidden_decisions: new ObjectKind, FieldId, OperationKind, protobuf tag or canonical schema field
duplicate Document, Selection, Session, History, RuntimeScene or canonical write owner
public C ABI/SDK or docs/api normative rewrite
dynamic registry, implicit network/file I/O, Core-created OS thread/message loop
POC-06/Arc revival, G5 performance engineering, Android delivery
modification of Authority, Gate, Evidence, Integration, Golden or historical PHYS records

document_manifest.authority: Accepted ADR-0013 ResourceManifest in Document semantic state
document_manifest.source: NOT PRESENT as a typed field/type in the accepted repository implementation at task anchor
document_manifest.observation: SemanticSnapshot contains only document_id, schema_version and objects; ImageContent/TextStyle/Brush bindings contain ResourceId references, but no ResourceManifest entry/revision/hash/length/decode-layout representation.
document_manifest.required_resolution: P12/P13 semantic Authority must bind an existing manifest representation or explicitly authorize one before R2 production mutation.
document_manifest.trust_rule: Provider response hash/version is not an authority; composition must stop BLOCKED_AUTHORITY until the canonical source is bound.

composition_snapshot.owner: composition attach/open copies the Document ResourceManifest entry into an internal binding snapshot
composition_snapshot.trust_rule: Derived snapshot is not a second canonical owner and cannot invent entries or change Document digest.

brush.source: semantic::BrushResourceBinding in canonical BrushExecutionSnapshot, cross-checked against Document ResourceManifest
brush.trust_rule: content_sha256/kind/decode_version must agree with the manifest and provider result.

image_font.source: Document ResourceManifest entry referenced by ImageContent/TextStyle ResourceId
image_font.trust_rule: ImageContent and TextStyle ResourceId alone do not authorize bytes; no manifest means unverified/missing.

upstream_authority_blocker.reason: ADR-0013 requires ResourceManifest semantic state, but the accepted repository implementation has no manifest representation consumable by composition.
